name: codesafer
description: CodeSafer is an MCP server that scans AI-generated code for 9 categories of hidden security threats — including invisible Unicode, Trojan Source, homoglyphs, and rules file backdoors — using static analysis plus CodeBERT deep learning. Runs locally, free tier available.
